notes.title: Demo Available Now!

notes.title: Color Breakers is back with a new publisher!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I am happy to finally announce that Color Breakers 2 is coming to Steam in 2025! The game will feature much more chaos and fun than ever before with support for up to 8 players in both local and online multiplayer.

I’ve been working on this game for over 2 years now and I can’t wait to share more information and details with you in the following months. I’m putting my heart and soul into this game and I hope that you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.

As a solo developer it’s really hard to balance the process of making a game with the community building and marketing efforts that are crucial for a game’s success. For that reason, I am happy to announce that I have partnered up with indie.io to bring Color Breakers 2 to life. I highly recommend checking out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]their page[/url] to see all the awesome indie titles that they support.

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

I’d like to take this opportunity to encourage you to wishlist the game and to follow us on socials to stay tuned on the game’s development and to be informed about any news regarding the game.

Thanks for your support and I hope to see you in Color Breakers 2!
